title: Digital Marketing
description: A practical beginner course for school leavers who want to help businesses find customers online. You will learn how to plan, create and measure marketing on Facebook, Instagram, TikTok, WhatsApp, email and Google, and how to offer these skills as a paid service to local businesses.
outcomes: Describe a business's target audience and write a clear marketing message for them
Set up and use Facebook, Instagram, TikTok and WhatsApp Business for a small business
Plan a month of content with a simple content calendar
Write short, persuasive copy for posts, adverts and emails
Apply basic SEO and read simple results such as reach, clicks and conversions
Package and price marketing services for local businesses
